name: Row of feature chips getting checked
description: A row of two to four white pill chips with short mono uppercase labels drops in across the top of the frame, then the chips are ticked off one after another: each fills orange from the left, a white check mark draws itself, and the chip pops with a small ring.
use_when: Lines that run through a short list of features, steps or things it does ('it adds b-roll, layouts, captions and motion graphics'), or a checklist being completed as the speaker names each item.

items.help: 2-4 short labels, each under ~12 characters, e.g. ['B-roll', 'Layouts', 'Captions', 'Motion gfx']

checked.help: how many chips (from the left) are already checked when the scene starts

check_to.help: how many are checked by the end; default all

at.help: optional seconds from the scene start when each chip (after the pre-checked ones) gets checked; default evenly spread
